messages:
maria: quick question — when the gateway sees an upstream midstream 5xx while streaming from model, do we short-circuit to client immediately or attempt a hedged retry upstream?
aj: depends on side effects + client deadline. for pure generation, i lean retry/hedge. for side-effecting ops, short-circuit and return an error.
maria: agreed. but what about leakiness: we already sent partial tokens to client. short-circuiting there looks bad for UX.
theo: we should distinguish two signals: user-visible partial response vs internal retry intent. propose headers: `x-rw-retry-mode: hedged|failfast` and `x-rw-retry-id: <uuid>` so frontdoors can correlate.
priya: +1. also add `x-rw-client-deadline-ms` so hedging respects original deadline instead of creating new attempts that blow past client timeout.
francis: ops concern: hedges can double GPU work. need a budget at ingress. maybe `Retry-Budget` token that is consumed only for non-idempotent safe calls?
aj: good call. we already have tenant quotas, but this should be per-request budget. smaller budget for streaming long responses.
maria: proposal: 1) gateway emits `x-rw-retry-id` on initial attempt. 2) on midstream 5xx, if `retry-mode=hedged` and remaining client time > min_retry_window, spawn single hedge attempt. 3) propagate `x-rw-retry-id` so result selection is deterministic.
theo: reconcile with connection short-circuit: if client closed stream, we must cancel hedges immediately. otherwise we waste. gateway should listen to client FIN and cancel upstream attempts.
priya: cancellation policy needs to be explicit in API: `client_close -> cancel_all_upstreams`. yes. also log `retry-phase` in traces for debugging.
francis: will add metrics: `hedge_attempts_total`, `hedge_wins_total`, `hedge_cost_ms` and `shortcircuit_count`. ops-bot: scheduled a runbook update task: RW-4821.
aj: edge-case: partial payload with side-effects (e.g., downstream webhooks triggered by model). we should default to `failfast` for routes labeled `side-effecting=true` in route config.
maria: can we make the route config dynamic? feature flag per-route works. add safe default = failfast.
theo: implementation note: keep hedged attempt cold-start mitigation by copying KVCACHE prefix if available. avoid full re-tokenization.
priya: code sketch for header handling:
```
// ingress handler pseudocode
let rid = req.header('x-rw-retry-id') || gen_uuid();
req.header('x-rw-retry-id', rid);
let mode = req.header('x-rw-retry-mode') || route.default_retry_mode;
if (midstream_5xx && mode == 'hedged' && remaining_ms > MIN_RETRY_MS) spawn_hedge(rid);
```
francis: one more: client-visible ordering. if hedge finishes with earlier tokens than current, we should not reorder tokens client already saw. select winner and truncate as needed, then emit note in logs.
maria: ok this is shaping up. next actions: repo RFC for `retry headers + budget + per-route policy`, ops to add metrics and runbook, eng-runtime to prototype hedged spawn + cancel on FIN. i'll file follow-ups. :thumbsup:
